objective: sustain a large, healthy population with high trait diversity and no energy collapse

directive.objective: sustain a large, healthy population with high trait diversity and no energy collapse
directive.rationale: To achieve the objective, we need to set the knobs to values that promote a stable, high-population environment with diverse traits and sustainable energy levels. The strategy for each species will be determined based on their traits and the environment.

species.name: SmallHerbivore
species.note: To conserve energy and space, SmallHerbivore should reduce its metabolism and increase its energy capacity.

species.name: MediumHerbivore
species.note: MediumHerbivore can benefit from cooperative behaviors to ensure food availability and reduce competition.

species.name: LargeHerbivore
species.note: LargeHerbivore needs to be competitive to access food resources and prevent overpopulation.

species.name: SmallCarnivore
species.note: SmallCarnivore can explore new areas and niche opportunities to maintain population diversity.

species.name: MediumCarnivore
species.note: MediumCarnivore can also explore and find new sources of food and resources.

species.name: Predator
species.note: Predators should continue to explore and find new prey or food sources.
